issues.claim: V09 §4.9's `info.crisis.<line>` row (l. 2192) gives the why line four forms — `line`, `lineOpen` (no `untilWeek`), `lineUnnamed` (no `name`), `preview` — and `ruinedFor` one: "For now: {look}, {condition}, weeks {a}–{b}". Round 4's §4.21.12 (4) (l. 3624–3634) gives `ruinedFor` as the why card's `facts` row to every building a disaster look stands over, "under a preview … every building of the preview's units", and §4.21.13 (3) (l. 3700–3705) makes it the plan panel's head there ("its words from the look's entry … or the preview's"); row 92 and T-V9-86 add "under a `disaster` preview the look". A preview's entry has no condition, name or weeks (§11.2's `LooksAnswer.crises[]`: `condition?` "absent on a preview", `sinceWeek?`, `untilWeek?`, l. 16321–16322; V10 §3.9b (8): "no condition, name, source or weeks"), so on the standalone preview — "the only way to see a look on a map without a dossier" (§4.21.12 (2)) — the row's slots have no values. A standing look with no `untilWeek` (row 90's open condition) or no `name` meets the same one form, and the why line itself has no form for a look with neither (`lineOpen` needs `{condition}`, `lineUnnamed` needs `{b}`); V10 §2.13's `says` (l. 1013) lists the same four keys. Two builders render different words, or fail on a missing slot, on a common path.
issues.required_change: V09 §4.9's `info.crisis.<line>` row adds after `lineUnnamed`: `lineUnnamedOpen` "{look}, since week {a}"; and after `ruinedFor`: `ruinedForOpen` "For now: {look}, {condition}, since week {a}" · `ruinedForUnnamed` "For now: {look}, weeks {a}–{b}" · `ruinedForUnnamedOpen` "For now: {look}, since week {a}" · `ruinedForPreview` "For now: {look} — a preview". §4.21.12 (4): after the `lineUnnamed` clause add "`info.crisis.lineUnnamedOpen` ("{look}, since week {a}") for a look with neither"; after "(`info.crisis.ruinedFor`, "For now: {look}, {condition}, weeks {a}–{b}"; V09 §5.8)" add "— in the form the line takes: `ruinedForOpen`, `ruinedForUnnamed`, `ruinedForUnnamedOpen`, or under a preview `ruinedForPreview` ("For now: {look} — a preview")". §4.21.13 (3): "under the head `info.crisis.ruinedFor`" → "under the head `info.crisis.ruinedFor` in the form (4) chooses (under a preview `ruinedForPreview`)". Row 90 adds the edge "a condition with neither a name nor an `untilWeek`" with the outcome "`info.crisis.lineUnnamedOpen`"; row 92's outcome "the look's lines, a preview never handing over" reads "the look's lines under `info.crisis.ruinedForPreview`, a preview never handing over". T-V9-85 adds "a previewed `disaster`'s why card on a building of its units carries "For now: Ruined quarters — a preview", and a look with no `untilWeek` the open form"; T-V9-86's "and under a `disaster` preview the look" reads "and under a `disaster` preview the look under `info.crisis.ruinedForPreview`". END (V10): §2.13's `says` comment reads "V09's line — info.crisis.line, .lineOpen, .lineUnnamed, .lineUnnamedOpen or .preview —"; §3.23 row 34 adds the edge "a condition with neither a name nor an `untilWeek`" with the outcome "worded `info.crisis.lineUnnamedOpen`".

issues.claim: V09 §4.21.12 (5) (l. 3641–3651) frames the crisis card's **Show** — and (7) Find's **Go to** on a look — on "the box of the marks `live.crises` draws for that look (§8.2's look rows, keyed by its condition, a preview by its look kind …), asked of the provider in the generation worker at the look's row's `band` over the map's `bounds` and that ring whatever the view (§8.2's `LiveLayerProvider.marks`)"; V09 §1b (l. 377) reads "`live.crises`' marks by look (§8.2)". §8.2 states no such key: *The layer* (l. 13134–13142) gives the marks only "of semantics `crisis.<part>`", and no column of a crisis mark is said to carry its look (`MarkTable.entity`, l. 12351, is unstated for them). The parts are shared between looks (l. 13084–13096): `campCluster` by siege, blockade, refugeeCamp, quarantine and occupation; `barricade` by blockade, raiders and rebellion; `crisis.ash` footprints by siege and raiders. With several looks standing — T-V9-85's own dossier fixture holds a siege, a refugee wave and a plague — a builder of `live.crises` from §8.2 gives V09 no way to tell one look's camps from another's, so Show and Go to cannot frame one look as V09 states: an input the build needs with no producer. Round 4's repair asked rendering (HAND-OFFS) only to name the reader.
issues.required_change: Rendering §8.2 *The layer*, after "… and, a `base` layer, joins the tile key (§8.8).": "Each mark carries its look: in `entity`, the interned handle (§2.1) of the `ConditionOverlay` whose look draws it — a preview's marks none, the preview drawn alone — so one look's marks are told apart; V09 §4.21.12 (5)'s **Show** and Find's **Go to** on a look read them so, asking the provider in the generation worker for one look's marks at its row's `band` over the map's `bounds` and §8.8's ring, whatever the view, and framing their box." T-ER-27 adds "with a siege and a refugee camp standing together, every `live.crises` mark carries its own look's overlay, and the box of one look's marks holds that look's parts alone". (V09's text stands; its §1b row then cites a stated producer.)

issues.claim: V09 §4.21.12 (4) (l. 3624–3625) and §5.8 (l. 3992–3993) give `info.crisis.ruinedFor` to the why card "of a field a famine leaves bare". A famine bares a share of the `fields` place's faces — round(s × n) of them, by keyed draws on the render keys from the seed and the condition's id (§10.2 (c) l. 15630–15635, (d) l. 15642 and 15682, (f) l. 15710–15711) — so whether one field is bare is the generation worker's evaluation. Round 4 gave V09 that evaluation for a disaster's buildings (§11.2's `looks` asked with `building`, each `disaster` entry's `over`; R4-04 (c)) and none for a field: `building?` and `over` are defined for a building and a disaster look only (base l. 16280, 16325), and V09 may not run the placement on the main thread. So the card's famine row reads an input nothing produces: one builder shows it on every field while a famine stands, another on none, and no edge row or bar covers it (row 90, T-V9-85). (At THORP, HAMLET and VILLAGE a `VillageField`'s row is V07's provider's, R3-16 (e); this is the town ladder's field.)
issues.required_change: END (rendering): §11.2's `looks` member adds `field?: Id /* g item 122 (f): with it, each famine look says whether it draws that field bare (§10.2 (d)'s fields, (f)) */`, and `LooksAnswer.crises[].over`'s comment adds "; with the query's field, whether this famine look draws that field bare at the view's week (§10.2 (d)'s `fields`), evaluated in the generation worker". V09 §4.21.12 (4), after "… never a call to V01 or V06 on the main thread.": "A field a famine leaves bare is one the famine look draws bare (§10.2 (d)'s `fields`, (f)): the card reads it from the same reader asked with that field (`query({ kind: 'looks', view, field })`), each `famine` entry carrying `over`." §1b's crisis-lines row (l. 377) and §2.12's crisis-card row (l. 1007) add "for a field's why card, asked with that field, each `famine` entry's `over`"; row 90 adds the edge "the why card of a field a famine draws bare, and of one it leaves sown" with the outcome "`info.crisis.ruinedFor`; no crisis row"; T-V9-85 adds "on the dossier fixture with a famine at severity 0.5, the why card of a bare field carries `info.crisis.ruinedFor` and that of a field left sown none".

issues.claim: Round 4 added `read_map { kind: 'look'; building?: Ref }` (V10 §2.12 l. 954; §3.5; prompt rule 21, l. 1280). §3.23 row 34 (l. 2708) defines four building cases (one the look stands over, one whose rebuilding has begun, one of no unit, one of a previewed `disaster`'s units under Works) but not a `building` that names no building — an address no read returned, or an entity that is not a building (a district, a plot, a field). Row 6's `is_error` covers "an anchor naming an address the session never read" only, and §11.2's `building?: Id` says nothing of a non-building id; builders may answer an error, `over` false, or no `over`. Off the common path (the model sending a non-building), hence minor.
issues.required_change: V10 §3.23 row 34's edges add "a read asked with a `building` that names no building — an address no read returned, a district, a plot or a field" with the outcome "`over` absent on every look, every other field as without `building`"; T-V10-50 (33) adds the two cases.
